title: Edit Customer's existing fields keep their place
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, so the tier fields show.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Every field of today's Edit Customer (Today picture) shows in the same order.
  • The two tier fields are added under Default Shop Supplies and before Notes.
